say:1:1322546001:1.text: Thank you for saving us... I'm so sorry... We won't be so reckless again...
say:1:1322546001:1.source_cn: 感谢你们的营救……对不起，我们……我们再也不这么莽撞行...

say:2:1322546002:1.text: I'll contact Evergreen Conservatory and have them send someone to pick you up.
say:2:1322546002:1.source_cn: 我会联系冬青学会来接你们的。

say:4:1322546003:1.text: Sorry to trouble you again, Magister. We're lucky to have someone like you here in the Duchy of Whiteridge. Thank you so much for everything.
say:4:1322546003:1.source_cn: 这次又劳烦您了，魔法师大人。还好有您在白山公国，请允许...
